checks.title: No hardcoded secrets or private keys
checks.remediation: Move secrets to SSM/CI variables, rotate exposed credentials, and remove committed values from history when needed.

checks.title: Helmet security headers are enabled
checks.remediation: Install and apply helmet before API routes.

checks.title: Session-authenticated routes use CSRF protection
evidence: api/src/app.ts defines conditionalCsrf and applies it to state-changing route groups
checks.remediation: Apply CSRF protection to cookie-authenticated state-changing routes.

checks.title: Login and API rate limiting are enabled
checks.remediation: Add brute-force protection on login and a general API request limiter.

checks.title: Session cookies use httpOnly, secure-in-production, and sameSite
evidence: api/src/app.ts session cookie includes httpOnly, secure, and sameSite
checks.remediation: Set httpOnly, secure in production, and strict or lax sameSite on session cookies.

checks.title: SESSION_SECRET is required in production
evidence: api/src/app.ts throws when SESSION_SECRET is absent in production
checks.remediation: Fail startup in production when SESSION_SECRET is missing.

checks.title: CSP avoids unsafe-inline
checks.remediation: Replace inline scripts/styles with nonce or hashed CSP entries where practical.

checks.title: No unsafe DOM injection sinks
checks.remediation: Replace innerHTML/eval-style sinks with React rendering, DOM textContent, or a sanitizer with explicit allowlists.

checks.title: Authentication/session data is not cached in localStorage
checks.remediation: Prefer httpOnly cookies for session state and avoid caching identity/session details in localStorage.

checks.title: TLS verification is not disabled
checks.remediation: Use trusted CA bundles or managed certificates instead of disabling TLS verification.

checks.title: Dockerfiles avoid latest tags and declare a runtime user
checks.remediation: Pin base image tags and run containers as a non-root user.

checks.title: Terraform includes encryption-at-rest signals
evidence: Terraform should include Aurora storage encryption and S3/KMS encryption configuration
checks.remediation: Enable Aurora storage encryption and S3 server-side encryption with KMS where possible.

checks.title: Dependency audit has no high or critical advisories
checks.remediation: Run pnpm audit, upgrade affected packages, or document accepted risk with a patch plan.
